ACCESS: robots.txt (www.ellementry.com/robots.txt) is a standard Shopify robots.txt with no anthropic-ai/Claude/ClaudeBot disallow and no blanket User-agent:*/Disallow:/ - proceeded via tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with a browser UA) for every page; no block encountered, tier (b)/(c) not needed. TREE METHOD: fetched the homepage HTML and parsed the server-rendered mega-menu (li.menu-lv-item.menu-lv-1/2/3 markup) with BeautifulSoup(lxml) to get the full LV1>LV2>LV3 nav tree, cross-checked against the union of all 6 sitemap files (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 472 collection URLs) to find any Storage/Textile-relevant collection reachable outside the mega-menu. Confirmed h1 and canonical URL matched the requested slug on every leaf fetched (27 collection pages fetched total). QTY METHOD: each Shopify collection page renders an exact count in

N Results

immediately under the h1; used that verbatim. One exception (masala-box) uses a lighter template lacking that element - qty was instead taken from the page's own analytics data array (collectionProductsObj), which lists 2 distinct product handles, confirmed by counting unique "handle" keys in that JS array (evidence noted accordingly, confidence still HIGH since it is the page's own exact product list, not an estimate). TEXTILE: the site's 'Furnishings' mega-menu hub cleanly maps to home textiles - Living Linen>Cushion Cover, Bed Linen>Bedsheet, Table Linen>{Table Runner, Table Placemat, Napkin}, Kitchen Linen>{Apron, Dishtowel}; each of these LV2 groups has exactly one or a few LV3 children per the mega-menu, confirmed against the sitemap (no additional Furnishings-adjacent collection found: no curtains/rugs/towels/duvets/quilts/mattress-protectors/wardrobe-textile categories exist on this site - ellementry is primarily a tableware/kitchenware/home-decor brand). STORAGE: mapped from two mega-menu branches - Kitchenware>Organiser (Jar, Utensil Holder, Storage Basket, Storage Bin, Masala Box, Bread Box - all genuine storage/organization products per storage.md SS4/SS5/SS7/SS13) and Furniture&Lighting>Storage (Cabinet, Chest Of Drawers, Trolley) plus Furniture&Lighting>Utility (Towel Hanger, matches storage.md SS19 'Towel Storage Racks' example). Also added 3 genuine storage collections found only via the XML sitemap (not linked from the mega-menu, discovered via the 'Related Links' text on the masala-box page and confirmed by canonical self-referencing + real h1 + nonzero product_count): Kitchen Storage Box (10), Kitchen Shelves (21), Kitchen Storage Shelf/kitchen-organiser-shelf (4) - recorded as standalone leaves since they sit outside the formal nav hierarchy. EXCLUDED: Kitchen Roll Holder (dispenser/holder, not a storage/organization function per rules) and Basket-1 (0 products currently, and titled/nav-placed as a Tableware-Accessories dining basket, not Storage); Bathroom (orphaned 1-product furniture/accessories hub, room-designation only, not in mega-menu); Box, Tea Box, Bar Cabinet (all 0-product orphaned SEO landing pages not reachable from the mega-menu, no genuine listing to record); Living Room Chest Of Drawers (orphaned duplicate of the already-recorded Chest Of Drawers collection, only 1 product, not in nav); Napkin Ring, Tissue Box, Caddy, Table Decor Basket, Dinnerware Basket, Wooden Tray, Tray, Serving Tray/Basket, Roti Box, Fruit Basket, Toast Rack, Tea Bag Rest, Cheese/Bread Board (all Kitchen&Dining/Tableware/Decor scope, not Textile/Storage); Wall Shelf, Wall Decor Shelf, Wooden Wall Shelves (Wall Decor scope, not Storage per storage.md SS18 boundary); Linen Products, Collection by Material/Style, all '*-collections' style/material tag pages, and all seasonal/gift/offer/percent-off/under-price marketing collections (View-All/Collection/promotional pages excluded per rule). Trolley kept in Storage but flagged LOW confidence/MANUAL REVIEW: one of its 2 products is an explicit 'bar trolley' (serving-purpose per storage.md SS20 boundary) though the site places the whole collection under its own 'Storage' nav group. No duplicate rows: every recorded URL is a distinct canonical collection slug.
